newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's BBV to sell metal coins in 2 more cities.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's BBV to sell metal coins in 2 more cities.

text.p: Mexico's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya said Monday it planned to sell silver and gold centenarian and ounce coins in two of Mexico's largest cities, Guadalajara and Monterrey, beginning some time between February and April.
The bank's assistant director for metals, Patricia Arceo, told Reuters the bank plans to offer the coins throughout the country on a gradual basis.
The Spanish bank, also known as BBV, already sells coins in Mexico City.
Gold and silver coins have been a popular investment option in the face of high Mexican inflation, which is believed to have reached about 29 percent for 1996.
BBV has begun selling the metals since it purchased the assets of Mexican bank Banco Cremi, formerly the nation's principal provider of metals.
